$comment: Experiment T13: what a font-table reader must do to agree with the browser it is standing in for. Regenerate with tools/ground-truth/fonts/metrics/analyse.ts. The fonts are built by tools/ground-truth/lib/truetype.ts and exist nowhere else, so no installed face can answer for a probe.

probes.asks: is the advance linear in size, or does the browser hint it
which table the font bounding box comes from
whether fsSelection bit 7 moves the box to the typo metrics
whether a legacy kern table is honoured at all
whether GPOS PairPos is honoured at all
which cmap subtable a reader must prefer when a font has two
which one wins when both are present and they disagree
whether the ideographic baseline is a BASE coordinate, and of which script
whether the lookup falls through to another script when DFLT is absent
whether a coordinate outside the em is reported as written or clamped
what a BASE table carrying no ideo coordinate falls back to

faceBox.$comment: The ascent and descent a browser reports for a face. Every real font sets hhea and usWin to the same numbers, so only a font built to disagree can say which was read.
faceBox.answer: usWin, or sTypo when fsSelection bit 7 is set

scores.model: hhea.ascender/descender
OS/2.usWinAscent/usWinDescent
OS/2.sTypoAscender/sTypoDescender
usWin, or sTypo when fsSelection bit 7 is set

kerning.$comment: A font may carry pair adjustments in a legacy kern table, in GPOS, or in both. The third probe sets them to different values, which is the only way to find out which one loses.
kerning.answer: GPOS when present, else the kern table

scores.model: the legacy kern table only
GPOS PairPos only
GPOS when present, else the kern table
the kern table when present, else GPOS
neither

width.$comment: Whether an advance is linear in size - that is, unhinted - and how the browser quantises it. The linear reading is what matters on a slide; the quantisation is what lets the reader's test assert equality instead of a tolerance.
width.answer: advance truncated, kern rounded, both at 1/65536 px

scores.model: exact float, no quantisation
advance and kern truncated at 1/65536 px
advance and kern rounded at 1/65536 px
advance truncated, kern rounded, both at 1/65536 px
the whole string quantised once at 1/65536 px

ideographic.$comment: Where an upright East Asian glyph puts its baseline. A BASE table names a coordinate per script per baseline tag, so the reading has to say which tag, which script, and what a font without one falls back to; three fonts disagree with themselves on all three.
ideographic.answer: the BASE ideo coordinate of the DFLT script, else the face box descent
